    "Introducing a recipe to uptrain existing multi-head language model checkpoints into models with Multi-Query Attention (MQA) using 5% of original pre-training compute.",

  "methodology": "The methodology involves two main steps: converting multi-head checkpoints to either MQA or GQA, and then performing additional pre-training to allow the model to adapt to its new structure.
